title: Mission District food and history Walking Tour: Small group
includes: Narrated food and history walking tour of Mission District.
Entrance fee to Mission San Francisco de Assis.
Plenty of stops with Photo opportunities.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Please note this is a walking tour, we kindly advise you to use comfortable clothes and shoes and be ready for some walking.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Be part of our exclusive sightseeing walking tour through San Francisco’s Mission district. We will explore the food and history of one of the most iconic neighborhoods in San Francisco. Dive deep inside its culture by trying delicious Oaxaca Mexican food and visiting the oldest church in SF Mission Dolores, classic Victorian architecture, and of course, the numerous murals celebrating the past and present Latin Culture.
